questions.background: Florida is holding a special election to complete the U.S. Senate term vacated by Marco Rubio after he became secretary of state.

Trimming Vindman 0.90 -> 0.85 and lifting Nixon 0.10 -> 0.15 better calibrates tail upset risk in an unpolled two-candidate primary.

Kuwait trims 0.26 -> 0.23 after Arab News's Aug 14 profile highlighted KPC's oil-export paralysis and Hormuz hostage vulnerability rather than trade retaliation. Bahrain trims 0.20 -> 0.18 (low bilateral trade cost, hawkish alignment). Qatar holds at 0.03 as Iranian FM Araghchi confirmed Aug 15 that Doha remains a diplomatic message channel despite Saturday's dispute over alleged detained Su-24 pilots (2% residual for Oman/Iraq).

local_articles.snippet: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has called for the Strait of Hormuz to reopen, stating that global oil flows must resume. He added that both Turkey and Iran support keeping oil moving through the strategic waterway at the centre of US–Iran tensions.

local_articles.title: Trump threatens to make the Strait of Hormuz a US territory: Can he?
local_articles.snippet: President Donald Trump on Friday said he would designate the Strait of Hormuz a territory of the United States “pretty soon” as the status of the waterway, a global chokepoint through which a fifth of global oil and gas passes, remains under a military and diplomatic deadlock. Iran has fired back, dubbing Trump’s threats as “nonsense” as the memorandum of understanding signed between the two in June expires on Sunday. questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Confirmation from German federal prosecutors or the authorities carrying out the arrest, as reported by reliable news organizations. Resolution Conditions : Identify the Ukrainian suspect physically arrested during August 2026 pursuant to a German warrant concerning the September 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings.
